_comment: MATLAB-produced reference metrics for the level-2 parity CI gate. Regenerate with code/python/tests/reference/runPhase5Metrics.m (see tests/reference/README.md). The 'Phase-5 specific' verification recorded these values from MATLAB R2024b + Gurobi 13.0 + RAVEN feat/yeast-gem-shared on the committed yeast-GEM.xml.

tolerances._rationale: Gurobi (MATLAB) vs HiGHS (cobrapy default in CI) solver drift around the 1e-6 growth-ratio threshold accounts for ~1-gene differences in the essential-gene confusion matrix and ~1e-3 differences in R^2 metrics.
